description: City of Yarra traffic counts is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Yarra. This data asset has information for point-in-time traffic counts on some roads within the Yarra municipality. The traffic count details include road name, related sections for that road where count was done, suburb, average volume of vehicles in each direction, total average volume and 85th percentile of observable speed. Coverage: City of Yarra. The portal files it under the publisher City of Yarra. Its tags are Traffic, Traffic counts, opencouncildata. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-08-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
